The 'so' joining the first two follows his own note, which opens with 死生出入，皆欽然自爾 before concluding there is no gate. verse.js ok (Zhuangzi 23.86, at 2328; the unclosed opening quote is as printed); entry-check.js ok. Plain sense matches day.js 23.85 (Space, Time, birth and death passing in and out through the Portal) without repeating the verse. No school, comparison or tone issue.
